0022600003.text: The San Antonio Spurs host the Oklahoma City Thunder in both teams' season openers, as neither side has played a 2026-27 game yet. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out after knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out with a calf strain), while Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (out after back surgery), Otega Oweh (out after Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out after knee surgery). The Spurs won the 2025-26 regular season series 4-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, with their most recent meeting a 111-103 playoff win in Oklahoma City on May 30, 2026.
